items.source: An implementation of DestinationResolver that interprets a destination name as the bean name of a MessageChannel and looks up the bean in the configured BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `DestinationResolver` 的类，它将目标名称解释为 `MessageChannel` 的 Bean 名称，并在配置的 `BeanFactory` 中查找该 Bean。

items.source: DestinationResolver implementation that proxies a target DestinationResolver, caching its CachingDestinationResolverProxy.resolveDestination(String) results.
items.translation: 实现 `DestinationResolver` 接口并代理目标 `DestinationResolver`，缓存其 `CachingDestinationResolverProxy.resolveDestination(String)` 的结果。

items.source: Configure the DestinationResolver to use to resolve String destination names into actual destinations of type <D>.
items.translation: 配置用于将字符串目的地名称解析为类型为 `<D>` 的实际目的地的 `DestinationResolver`。

items.source: Uses of DestinationResolver in org.springframework.messaging.core
items.translation: DestinationResolver 在 org.springframework.messaging.core 中的用法

items.source: Defines interfaces and implementation classes for messaging templates.
items.translation: 定义消息模板的接口和实现类。
返回配置的目的地解析器。

items.source: Set the target DestinationResolver to delegate to.
items.translation: 将目标 DestinationResolver 设置为委派给的对象。

items.source:
Create a new CachingDestinationResolverProxy using the given target
DestinationResolver to actually resolve destinations.
items.translation: 使用给定的目标 DestinationResolver 创建一个新的 CachingDestinationResolverProxy，以实际解析目的地。
